applyTo: "docs/agent-system/**"

This subtree is the repository-local agent operating system.

Before editing it, read `docs/agent-system/AGENTS.md`, `docs/agent-system/context/README.md`, `docs/agent-system/SCHEMAS.md`, and the smallest relevant local rule/role surface.

Keep root routing compact. Put detail in the narrowest durable local document. Preserve `NORMAL_REPO_WORK_EXTERNAL_FETCH_REQUIRED = FALSE` unless a deliberate self-sufficiency policy change is being made.

Evidence maturity and promotion scope are independent. Reviewer suggestions do not self-promote. Every confirmed anti-pattern record must carry immutable source-evidence edges appropriate to its claimed state.

Do not add private Notion/Drive URLs, personal memory, secrets, live provider bindings, private receipts, or raw private evidence. External AIOS governance is synchronized through the Knowledge Steward boundary, not fetched by every normal agent.

Role names, custom-agent profiles, rules, commands, and skills do not grant authority by themselves.
